lines: If you are wondering whether castor oil is only for babies, here you go.
I used castor oil to get my daughter's cradle cap out. But did you know people use it everywhere?
The problem is it's thick and drips all over your fingers.
This one rolls on with a rose quartz roller. Brows, cuticles, elbows, the ends of your hair.
USDA organic, cold pressed and hexane free.
Honestly, I'm upset I didn't find the roller first.
My old one isn't sold anymore, and dry winter skin is coming.
Grab one for your purse and one for your nightstand. It's in the orange cart.
